speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, can you tell me which antibiotic you were prescribed for your sinusitis and how long you took it? I also need to know if you have noticed any changes in your urine, such as blood or decreased output.

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you take any over-the-counter pain relievers, like ibuprofen or acetaminophen, for your sinusitis or current symptoms? I need to know if you have any history of kidney disease or allergies.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the rash after amoxicillin and current flank pain with fever, I am concerned for acute interstitial nephritis. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Serum_Creatinine, Complete_Blood_Count

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of eosinophils in your urine, combined with the negative bacterial culture and recent antibiotic use, strongly suggests acute interstitial nephritis. To confirm this diagnosis and rule out other causes, I need to see the specific imaging results. REQUEST IMAGES

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text: The imaging confirms renal enlargement without obstruction, which aligns perfectly with acute interstitial nephritis. I will discontinue the offending antibiotic and initiate corticosteroid therapy to reduce inflammation. DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis
